quest.title: Playing in the Snow Counts as Training Too!
quest.description: Looks like Klee has had quite the unusual encounter during the Cross Country Challenge. Let's go check on her now!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight}! Over here, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee just made some new friends! Wanna come play with us?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: They taught us a new game called Snowtrace.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The rules aren't hard. It's just a very special kind of hide-and-seek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww! Klee, Yaoyao, and Sayu, so you've all become friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From the name alone, this game sounds like an upgraded version of Windtrace, huh? Hehe, Paimon can't wait to play with you!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Achoo... Even though it isn't that cold at the camp, I'm still feeling a little sleepy...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: #Hmm? Are my eyes playing tricks on me, or do I see {NICKNAME} and Paimon?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: #Your eyes are working perfectly fine. That's {NICKNAME} and Paimon alright.

choices.text: Hey there, Yaoyao! Hey there, Sayu!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Good idea! Once we get moving and start having fun, we won't doze off that easily!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And didn't that awfully serious Miss Sumire say that spending more time in the snowy mountains would be good for your skills, Sayu?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Ugh, I can't believe you guys remembered that!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Alright... But if I lose to my peers or even to that super Ninken, slacking off is going to get a lot more difficult in the future.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Looks like I'm really going to have to pull up my socks on this trip.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And don't you worry! I came up with a new Goulash recipe using Jueyun Chili and ground pepper, and I just made some.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Take a few bites of it before you start. I promise you won't feel cold at all during the game.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: That sounds great! Hang on, I'll have a whole bowl first!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Alright then, let's get our game of hide-and-seek started here in the snowy mountain!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! The whole mountain's covered in snow — it's the perfect hiding spot for Paimon!

choices.text: I'd love to meet Klee's new friends too!
